craft.title: Craft
craft.remarks: Identifies the craft. This field is read-only, if the Labor/Craft field contains a craft. If you edit this field, the Rate and Premium Pay Code fields are updated automatically.

memo.title: Memo
memo.remarks: Describes any notes or comments about the performed work.

starttime.title: Start Time
starttime.remarks: Time at which work began. If you enter a Start Time and a Finish Time, Maximo calculates values for the Hours field, but will not write over a value you have already entered in the field. You can only enter a value if the work order has a status of Approve. You can modify the field until you save the record.

startdate.title: Start Date
startdate.remarks: Date on which the reported work began.

invoicelinenum.title: Invoice Line
invoicelinenum.remarks: Invoice line number of the invoice line created from this Labor Transaction.

rollup.title: Rolled Up
rollup.remarks: Indicates whether this transaction has been rolled up.

startdateentered.title: Start Date
startdateentered.remarks: Date on which the reported work began.

payrate.title: Rate
payrate.remarks: Pay rate for the labor. Maximo copies the pay rate for the labor from the labor record.

porevisionnum.title: PO Revision
porevisionnum.remarks: Revision number of the purchase order. Indicates how many times a purchase order has been revised.

financialperiod.title: Financial Period
financialperiod.remarks: Financial period in a format corresponding to that required by the accounting system.

enteredastask.title: Entered as Task
enteredastask.remarks: Was this transaction created against a work order task?

linecost.title: Line Cost
linecost.remarks: Extended or lump sum cost of labor transaction.

transtype.title: Type
transtype.remarks: The type of time being entered (work, travel, vacation, etc.). If you use WORK, TRAV, or WMATL as the type, you must enter a work order, GL account, asset, or location.

actualstaskid.title: Task
actualstaskid.remarks: Identifies the task for which you are reporting labor.

polinenum.title: PO Line
polinenum.remarks: Identifies the line number on the PO for the labor.

laborcode.title: Labor
laborcode.remarks: Identifies the person or craft performing the work.

outside.title: Outside
outside.remarks: Specifies whether the work was performed by an outside contractor or by an employee. If the check box is selected, the work was performed by a contractor. If the check box is cleared, the work was performed by an employee. Maximo selects or clears the check box based on the value in the Labor field.

finishtimeentered.title: End Time
finishtimeentered.remarks: Time at which the work was finished.

amcrew.title: Crew
amcrew.remarks: Identifies the crew that performed the work.

position.title: Position
position.remarks: Identifies the labor's position on the crew.

starttimeentered.title: Start Time
starttimeentered.remarks: Time at which work began. If you enter a Start Time and a Finish Time, Maximo calculates values for the Hours field, but will not write over a value you have already entered in the field. You can only enter a value if the work order has a status of Approve. You can modify the field until you save the record.

gldebitacct.title: GL Debit Account
gldebitacct.remarks: General ledger account to charge for the labor transaction.

invoicenum.title: Invoice
invoicenum.remarks: Invoice number of the invoice created from this Labor Transaction.

servrectransid.title: Service Receipt ID
servrectransid.remarks: Created when Create service Receipt is used

regularhrs.title: Regular Hours
regularhrs.remarks: Number of regular hours (not overtime, holiday, weekend, etc.) worked.

finishtime.title: End Time
finishtime.remarks: Time at which the work was finished.

skilllevel.title: Skill Level
skilllevel.remarks: Identifies the skill level of the labor.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Identifies the asset to which labor costs are charged.

crewworkgroup.title: Crew Work Group
crewworkgroup.remarks: Identifies the resource pool to which the labor belongs.

contractnum.title: Contract
contractnum.remarks: Identifies the contract for the outside labor for the transaction. You can select a contract based on the value in the Craft field or in the Labor field.

paymenttransdate.title: Recorded as Received
paymenttransdate.remarks: The date and time the transaction was recorded in Purchasing.

finishdate.title: End Date
finishdate.remarks: Date on which the labor finished the work. If you have entered a Start Date, Start Time, and Finish Time, Maximo calculates a value for the Finish Date field using this formula: (start date) + (finish time - start time). The work order must be approved before you can insert a value. You can modify the field until you save the record. Maximo then updates the Line Cost field.

glcreditacct.title: GL Credit Account
glcreditacct.remarks: General ledger account to which the cost of the labor is to be credited.

premiumpayratetype.title: Premium Rate Type
premiumpayratetype.remarks: Describes the type of premium rate, for example, hourly, incremental, or multiplier.

revisionnum.title: Revision
revisionnum.remarks: Identifies the Active Revision Number of the contract for this labor transaction.

premiumpaycode.title: Premium Pay Code
premiumpaycode.remarks: Identifies the premium pay code for this labor transaction, for example, holiday hours, Sunday hours, greater than 40 hours per week, greater than eight hours per shift.

premiumpayrate.title: Premium Pay Rate
premiumpayrate.remarks: Identifies the labor's rate for work done beyond the usual work shift, for example, the overtime rate. Maximo displays the premium pay rate in this read-only field and uses it to calculate the Line Cost.

ponum.title: PO
ponum.remarks: Identifies the purchase order that is purchasing the labor.The PO you select must have a service line, and the vendor on the PO must match the vendor on the selected labor/craft record.

timerstatus.title: Timer Status
timerstatus.remarks: Indicates whether a user created the labor transaction using the timer on the Maximo toolbar. If the field is blank, the timer was not used. If the field has a value, the timer was used to create this labor transaction.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Identifies the location to which labor costs are charged.

genapprservreceipt.title: Approved
genapprservreceipt.remarks: Specifies whether the labor transaction has been approved and a service receipt can be written. If the check box is selected, the transaction has been approved. If the check box is cleared, the transaction has not been approved. You can edit labor transactions until the work order is closed or cancelled.

finishdatetime.title: Start Date Time
finishdatetime.remarks: Time at which work began. If you enter a Start Time and a Finish Time, Maximo calculates values for the Hours field, but will not write over a value you have already entered in the field. You can only enter a value if the work order has a status of Approve. You can modify the field until you save the record.

qualmet.title: Qualification Met?
qualmet.remarks: Does this labor meet the qualification requirements?

finishdateentered.title: End Date
finishdateentered.remarks: Date on which the labor finished the work. If you have entered a Start Date, Start Time, and Finish Time, Maximo calculates a value for the Finish Date field using this formula: (start date) + (finish time - start time). The work order must be approved before you can insert a value. You can modify the field until you save the record. Maximo then updates the Line Cost field.

premiumpayhours.title: Premium Pay Hours
premiumpayhours.remarks: Number of hours for which the labor will be paid the premium rate.

startdatetime.title: Start Date Time
startdatetime.remarks: Time at which work began. If you enter a Start Time and a Finish Time, Maximo calculates values for the Hours field, but will not write over a value you have already entered in the field. You can only enter a value if the work order has a status of Approve. You can modify the field until you save the record.
